sections_target.text: Introduction

This document sets out the steps of the half-yearly maintenance, I2, M6, of the make-up pump, the pump responsible for maintaining the water pressure inside the fire-water lines at 8.5 bar; there are 2 pumps.
Technical specifications:

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mehtadi Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Rifi, approved by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and endorsed by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of the Nubaria Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, following the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment.
Maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Fence off the area to define the work area and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves ...).
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically.
Close the suction and discharge valves.

sections_target.text: Procedures to be Carried Out

rows: Check the Pressure Indicator on the fire line.
Check the pressure from the display on the pump.
Check the alarms from the auxiliary control panel and the main control panel.
Test the Pressure Switch inside the pump's control panel if necessary.
Check for any leaks from the suction and discharge valves.
Make sure there are no vibrations on the pump and check that the main bolts are tight.
Verify the alignment of the motor shaft with the pump shaft.
Verify the level and temperature of the cooling water.
Check the cleanliness of the fuel filters.
Verify the suction and discharge pipes and valves are sound.

Procedures to be Carried Out
1. | Check the Pressure Indicator on the fire line.
2. | Check the pressure from the display on the pump.
3. | Check the alarms from the auxiliary control panel and the main control panel.
4. | Test the Pressure Switch inside the pump's control panel if necessary.
5. | Check for any leaks from the suction and discharge valves.
6. | Make sure there are no vibrations on the pump and check that the main bolts are tight.
7. | Verify the alignment of the motor shaft with the pump shaft.
8. | Verify the batteries are sound.
9. | Verify the level and temperature of the cooling water.
10. | Measure the oil level.
11. | Check the cleanliness of the fuel filters.
12. | Verify the suction and discharge pipes and valves are sound.
